citation: Altman, E.I., Hartzell, J. & Peck, M. (1995), "Emerging Markets Corporate Bonds: A Scoring System", Salomon Brothers.

definition: Piotroski (2000) F-score: nine year-over-year binary fundamental-strength signals (4 profitability, 3 funding/liquidity, 2 efficiency) summed 0-9.
citation: Piotroski, J.D. (2000), "Value Investing: The Use of Historical Financial Statement Information to Separate Winners from Losers", Journal of Accounting Research, 38 (Supplement), pp. 1-41.

definition: Ohlson (1980) O-score: nine-term bankruptcy-probability logit (GNP-deflator term omitted; a rank-preserving additive shift).
citation: Ohlson, J.A. (1980), "Financial Ratios and the Probabilistic Prediction of Bankruptcy", Journal of Accounting Research, 18(1), pp. 109-131.

definition: Beneish (1999) eight-variable M-score for earnings-manipulation risk (DSRI, GMI, AQI, SGI, DEPI, SGAI, TATA, LVGI).
citation: Beneish, M.D. (1999), "The Detection of Earnings Manipulation", Financial Analysts Journal, 55(5), pp. 24-36.
